package main

// 只由 checkpoint 实验脚本复制到临时工程。正式模板不安装信号处理器。
import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"runtime/pprof"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

func init() {
	requests := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	signal.Notify(requests, syscall.SIGUSR2)
	go func() {
		for range requests {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "CHECKPOINT STACK BEGIN pid=%d utc=%s\n", os.Getpid(), time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano))
			if err := pprof.Lookup("goroutine").WriteTo(os.Stderr, 2); err != nil {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "CHECKPOINT STACK ERROR %v\n", err)
			}
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "CHECKPOINT STACK END")
		}
	}()
}
